description: The declarations of a model as a tree: packages, definitions, usages, requirements, states, each with its kind, qualified name, short name (id) and line. Use it to find what to edit.

language.description: The notation of the text: "sysml" (default) or "kerml" for a KerML document (.kerml).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

name: outline
title: Outline a model
